title: Jumio Android SDK v4.14.0
impact_summary: The SDK adds Digital Identity support using eIDAS for selected countries, expanding compliance with EU digital identity regulations.
backbase_rationale: Backbase does not need to act unless the application targets the specific eIDAS countries covered by this feature.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.18.0
impact_summary: The SDK’s minimum supported Android version has increased to 24 (Nougat), requiring projects to update their minSdkVersion.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must update Android projects to meet the new minSdk requirement to continue using the SDK.
